001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder;
002
003import java.util.function.Consumer;
004
005import org.eclipse.jdt.annotation.Nullable;
006
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.ExtendedFieldPrefix;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.JSONToken;
016
017/**
018 * A JSON encoder resembling
019 * <a href="https://logback.qos.ch/manual/encoders.html#JsonEncoder">Logback's own
020 * opinionated <code>ch.qos.logback.classic.encoder.JsonEncoder</code></a>.
021 * <p>
022 * Fields written: <code>timestamp</code> (epoch millis), <code>nanoseconds</code>
023 * (nanosecond-of-second, for sub-millisecond precision), <code>level</code>,
024 * <code>threadName</code>, <code>loggerName</code>, <code>mdc</code> (nested object of
025 * the event's key values), <code>message</code> (already formatted), and
026 * <code>throwable</code> (nested object with <code>className</code>, <code>message</code>
027 * and a <code>stepArray</code> of stack frame objects, recursing into <code>cause</code>
028 * if present).
029 * <p>
030 * Unlike Logback's encoder, which is independently configurable per field via
031 * {@code <withXxx>} elements, <code>sequenceNumber</code> is intentionally not
032 * implemented (Rainbow Gum has no context-wide sequence number generator, see
033 * {@code %lsn}/{@code %sn} in the pattern module discussion), <code>context</code> is
034 * omitted (Rainbow Gum has no equivalent to Logback's {@code LoggerContext}), and
035 * <code>kvpList</code> is omitted because Rainbow Gum does not distinguish MDC-origin key
036 * values from SLF4J fluent {@code addKeyValue} ones - both already end up merged into
037 * {@link LogEvent#keyValues()}, which this encoder writes as <code>mdc</code>.
038 */
039public final class LogbackJsonEncoder extends LogEncoder.AbstractEncoder<JsonBuffer> {
040
041        /**
042         * Logback JSON encoder URI scheme.
043         */
044        public static final String LOGBACK_SCHEME = "logback";
045
046        private final boolean prettyprint;
047
048        LogbackJsonEncoder(boolean prettyprint) {
049                super();
050                this.prettyprint = prettyprint;
051        }
052
053        /**
054         * Creates a Logback JSON encoder using a lambda for easier registration. The builder
055         * will have properties loaded after the consumer has configured the builder.
056         * @param consumer lambda to configure builder.
057         * @return encoder provider.
058         */
059        public static LogProvider<LogbackJsonEncoder> of(Consumer<LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder> consumer) {
060                return (s, c) -> {
061                        var b = new LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder(s);
062                        consumer.accept(b);
063                        return b.fromProperties(c.properties()).build();
064                };
065        }
066
067        /**
068         * Creates a Logback JSON encoder.
069         * @param name property name prefix.
070         * @param prettyPrint <code>true</code> will pretty print the JSON, default is false.
071         * @return encoder.
072         */
073        @LogConfigurable(prefix = LogProperties.ENCODER_PREFIX)
074        static LogbackJsonEncoder of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @Nullable Boolean prettyPrint) {
075                prettyPrint = prettyPrint == null ? false : prettyPrint;
076                return new LogbackJsonEncoder(prettyPrint);
077        }
078
079        @Override
080        protected JsonBuffer doBuffer(BufferHints hints) {
081                return new JsonBuffer(this.prettyprint, ExtendedFieldPrefix.UNDERSCORE);
082        }
083
084        @Override
085        protected void doEncode(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer) {
086                buffer.clear();
087                var formattedMessage = buffer.getFormattedMessageBuilder();
088                event.formattedMessage(formattedMessage);
089                var now = event.timestamp();
090                var t = event.throwableOrNull();
091
092                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_START);
093                int index = 0;
094                index = buffer.writeLong("timestamp", now.toEpochMilli(), index, 0);
095                index = buffer.writeInt("nanoseconds", now.getNano(), index, 0);
096                index = buffer.write("level", LevelFormatter.toString(event.level()), index);
097                index = buffer.write("threadName", event.threadName(), index);
098                index = buffer.write("loggerName", event.loggerName(), index);
099
100                int mdcIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart("mdc", index, 0);
101                var kvs = event.keyValues();
102                for (int i = kvs.start(); i >= 0; i = kvs.next(i)) {
103                        mdcIndex = buffer.write(kvs.key(i), kvs.valueOrNull(i), mdcIndex, 0);
104                }
105                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
106                index++;
107
108                index = buffer.write("message", formattedMessage.toString(), index);
109
110                if (t != null) {
111                        index = writeThrowable("throwable", t, buffer, index);
112                }
113
114                if (index > 0 && prettyprint) {
115                        buffer.writeLineFeed();
116                }
117                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_END);
118                buffer.writeLineFeed();
119        }
120
121        private static int writeThrowable(String field, Throwable t, JsonBuffer buffer, int index) {
122                int throwableIndex = buffer.writeObjectStart(field, index, 0);
123                throwableIndex = buffer.write("className", t.getClass().getName(), throwableIndex, 0);
124                throwableIndex = buffer.write("message", t.getMessage(), throwableIndex, 0);
125
126                int arrayIndex = buffer.writeArrayStart("stepArray", throwableIndex, 0);
127                for (var frame : t.getStackTrace()) {
128                        int frameIndex = buffer.writeArrayElementObjectStart(arrayIndex);
129                        frameIndex = buffer.write("className", frame.getClassName(), frameIndex, 0);
130                        frameIndex = buffer.write("methodName", frame.getMethodName(), frameIndex, 0);
131                        frameIndex = buffer.write("fileName", frame.getFileName(), frameIndex, 0);
132                        frameIndex = buffer.writeInt("lineNumber", frame.getLineNumber(), frameIndex, 0);
133                        buffer.writeArrayElementObjectEnd();
134                        arrayIndex++;
135                }
136                buffer.writeArrayEnd();
137                throwableIndex++;
138
139                var cause = t.getCause();
140                if (cause != null && cause != t) {
141                        writeThrowable("cause", cause, buffer, throwableIndex);
142                }
143
144                buffer.writeObjectEnd();
145                return index + 1;
146        }
147
148}
